title: K2 CScrollbarSlider::MouseDown Vtable Slot 32 Hook & CSlider::MouseDown Track Click-to-Jump Guard

branch_annotations.condition: this->m_pParent (+0x88) == nullptr -> falls through to CSlider::MouseDown (+0x9C9D80)
eButton == 0x13A (BUTTON_WHEELUP) -> invokes FUN_1809A6690 and falls through
eButton != 0x13B (BUTTON_WHEELDOWN), including 0x137 (BUTTON_MOUSEL) -> early RET at 0x9A6C14 in retail; intercepted by Hooked_CScrollbarSlider_MouseDown to invoke CSlider::MouseDown (+0x9C9D80)
CSlider::MouseDown loads m_pHandle (*(CSliderHandle**)(this + 0x190)) and dereferences [m_pHandle + 0x48] and [v2CursorPos] (+0x9C9E76) before calling CSliderHandle::DoSlide (+0x9CB200)

struct_offsets.0x00: vptr (CScrollbarSlider vtable @ k2_x64.dll+0xF52C38; CSlider vtable @ k2_x64.dll+0xF56B00)

provenance_chain.ui_trigger: Left-click (BUTTON_MOUSEL = 0x137) on any K2 <scrollbar> slider track

triangulation.static_source: Ghidra ProjectKongor.rep (/k2_x64.dll-64104e) + raw PE .rdata/.text inspection confirming CScrollbarSlider vtable @ 0xF52C38, slot 32 @ 0xF52D38 -> 0x1809A6BB0 (RVA 0x9A6BB0, 16B prologue 48 89 5C 24 08 48 89 74 24 10 57 48 83 EC 20 48), and CSlider vtable @ 0xF56B00, slot 32 @ 0xF56C00 -> 0x1809C9D80 (RVA 0x9C9D80, 16B prologue 81 FA 37 01 00 00 0F 85 2F 01 00 00 48 89 6C 24).
triangulation.dynamic_source: NativeGuard vtable slot verification + native_guard_unit_tests synthetic vtable/prologue mismatch and button-routing tests.

counterevidence_searched: Decompiled both CScrollbarSlider::MouseDown (+0x9A6BB0) and CSlider::MouseDown (+0x9C9D80..+0x9C9EBB) plus CScrollbar::CScrollbar (+0x9A4A60). Confirmed CScrollbarSlider (size 0x270) is a direct subclass of CSlider with zero layout shift, and identified that CSlider::MouseDown unconditionally dereferences m_pHandle (*(void**)(this + 0x190)) at +0x9C9E1E and cursorPos (R8) at +0x9C9E76 without null guards.
negative_control: When vtable slot 0xF52D38 does not point to pBase + 0x9A6BB0 or either prologue at +0x9A6BB0 / +0x9C9D80 mismatches retail bytes, VMT hook installation aborts cleanly without mutating .rdata; at runtime, non-0x137 buttons (0x13A wheel-up, 0x13B wheel-down) and null m_pHandle / null cursorPos inputs bypass CSlider::MouseDown (+0x9C9D80) without faulting.
post_patch_state_invariant: If VMT signature verification fails or runtime pointer guards reject null thisPtr/cursorPos/m_pHandle, CScrollbarSlider vtable[32] and widget state remain untouched and wheel scrolling continues via retail CScrollbarSlider::MouseDown (+0x9A6BB0).
negative_control_crash_input: Mismatched k2_x64.dll build where +0xF52D38 != pBase+0x9A6BB0, or BUTTON_MOUSEL (0x137) dispatch with cursorPos == nullptr or m_pHandle (*(void**)(this+0x190)) == nullptr.

obligations.description: Before patching CScrollbarSlider vtable slot 32 (k2_x64.dll + 0xF52D38), verify that *ppSlot equals retail CScrollbarSlider::MouseDown (pBase + 0x9A6BB0, or is already Hooked_CScrollbarSlider_MouseDown), verify the 15-byte RIP-free prologue at pBase + 0x9A6BB0 (48 89 5C 24 08 48 89 74 24 10 57 48 83 EC 20), and verify the 12-byte CMP/JNZ prologue at CSlider::MouseDown pBase + 0x9C9D80 (81 FA 37 01 00 00 0F 85 2F 01 00 00), aborting VMT hook installation with diagnostic logging on any mismatch.

In Hooked_CScrollbarSlider_MouseDown, guard against null thisPtr, null cursorPos, and null CSlider::m_pHandle (*(void* const*)((const uint8_t*)thisPtr + 0x190) == nullptr) before invoking CSlider::MouseDown (k2_x64.dll + 0x9C9D80) on BUTTON_MOUSEL (0x137) inside a protected SEH frame, while delegating BUTTON_WHEELUP (0x13A), BUTTON_WHEELDOWN (0x13B), and all non-0x137 buttons to g_origScrollbarSliderMouseDown (k2_x64.dll + 0x9A6BB0).

Preserve original CScrollbarSlider::MouseDown pointer (g_origScrollbarSliderMouseDown = pBase + 0x9A6BB0) prior to VMT slot write, ensure idempotent re-entry if *ppSlot already equals Hooked_CScrollbarSlider_MouseDown, and restore original .rdata page permissions via VirtualProtect after writing k2_x64.dll + 0xF52D38.

limitations_and_unknowns.triangulation_notes: Confirmed across Ghidra ProjectKongor.rep (/k2_x64.dll-64104e) and both on-disk client binaries (games/client/k2_x64.dll and games/client/windows-x64/k2_x64.dll): vtable slot 0xF52D38 == 0x1809A6BB0 and CSlider vtable slot 0xF56C00 == 0x1809C9D80.

indirect_calls.rationale: Invoked inside retail CSlider::MouseDown after verifying m_pHandle (+0x190) is non-null.

notes: See FN-011 for K2 manual clip-scroll pattern; this VMT hook enables native track click-to-jump on all K2 CScrollbarSlider instances without bypassing mousewheel step handlers (0x13A / 0x13B).
